# Gradle Wrapper bootstrap note

`gradle-wrapper.properties` targets Gradle 9.8.0.

The binary `gradle-wrapper.jar` is generated by Gradle and is intentionally not recreated from source in this archive. If it is not already present after applying this milestone on top of the repository, regenerate the wrapper once with:

```bash
gradle wrapper --gradle-version 9.8.0
```

In the original repository, keep the existing wrapper scripts/JAR when applying the refactor and regenerate them with the command above so all wrapper components are consistent.
